description: A server that answers initialize with a protocol revision the client does not implement. Pins Rust McpConnection::initialize against MCP_CLIENT_ACCEPTED_PROTOCOL_VERSIONS: the handshake ends with the supported list in the error, nothing is advertised, only initialize reaches the server, and a later call to one of the server's tools gets the same refusal (the pool reconnects lazily at call time) instead of an unknown-tool error.
